If the OUT_FN_Response_FLT_CNT (Coming from FB5601) is greater than or equal to 1 the FlexNet_OEM_No_Response_Warning bit will turn on. This Bit needs to trigger a Warning message on the HMI.
No FlexNet Response Warning Bit

If the OUT_FN_Response_FLT_CNT (Coming from FB5601) is greater than or equal to the FN_RESPONSE_COUNT_ALLOWED number entered on the HMI the FlexNet_OEM_No_Response_Fault bit will turn on. This Bit needs to trigger a L2 end of cycle fault. If the FN_RESPONSE_COUNT_ALLOWED number entered on the HMI is set to Zero the Bypass bit will turn on and not allow the Fault bit to turn on.
No FlexNet Response Fault Bit

If the current Trasaction required a retry before there was a response from the FlexNet Server the FlexNet_OEM_Transaction_Retry_Occurred bit will turn on. When this bit turns on there must be a Warning message on the HMI stating that a FlexNet Transaction Retry Occurred.
Flexnet Retry Occured
